caption: The 140 stills with the strongest circle in the archive cache, out of 3,443 found by a Hough scan. The red ring is what the detector found; the number is how much of the rim sits on a real edge. Read by eye, most of the top hits are dials, lenses, TV tubes and logos.
The same scan over one frame every three seconds of the 405 clips (1,459 circles). Moving circles: a clock, a reel, a wheel, a jet engine, a sun.
Finalists as strips across their clips, to see whether the circle holds still or moves.

Measuring each rim. Red, green and blue are the three best circles the detector offers; the one used is picked by hand. This is where the detector failed on the reel, the wheel and the octagon, and where the hand marks came from.
